verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows SerpApi letting users configure scheduled, recurring, or background automations. The `async` parameter only submits a single search and fetches its result later, which is a one-off action rather than a recurring schedule. Automatic Early Renewal is a billing setting, and the brand-monitoring use case does not document any scheduler, so neither counts as an automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
